remarks: Welcome to this light, bright, and spacious three-bedroom, three-bathroom home in the highly desirable Aldenhouse community of Ladera Ranch. Featuring an inviting open floor plan, thoughtfully designed living spaces, and beautiful upgrades throughout, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and functionality. The open and welcoming floor plan features three generously sized bedrooms, including a convenient main-level bedroom with a full bathroom, ideal for guests, extended family, or flexible living arrangements. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers quality appliances, generous cabinetry, ample counter space, and a seamless flow into the main living and dining areas.
